blurb: Spend an entire day exploring the Willamette Valley wine region, world famous for its Pinot Noir, rolling hills and fresh local ingredients. Our tour guides are local experts in Oregon, and you will gain an insider's perspective about our state. During your wine tasting experience, immerse in the region's history and growing practises as we visit 3-4 select vineyards surrounded by stunning views, unique architecture as you sip and taste exceptional wines. Expect to be pampered, entertained, and truly have a memorable trip in Oregon's Wine Country. We will carefully plan out your day including making all necessary reservations, including a planned lunch stop at either a vineyard or local restaurant. Our goal is for your group to bring home lasting memories and we strive to achieve this by curating the best day spent in Oregon's wine country by planning your itinerary and handling all reservations. Prices are based on group size so proceed to checkout to see final price.
